First run: confirm the live store migrated 9->10 and that a new v2-pre-migrate-*.db exists under ~/Library/Application Support/LocalFlow/v2-evidence/backups/. (1) Correct 'Claude' in one coding-app dictation via History > Teach; in Models > Training Data > Review approve the narrow rule, then try a counterexample such as 'cloud deployment' - approval refused if it would flip; dictate the phrase again and confirm the rule applies only in that app. (2) Insights > Your Voice > Generate; open a card's evidence ids, Exclude one, confirm the snapshot invalidates and regeneration omits it; delete one supporting dictation everywhere and confirm no card or phrase keeps it. (3) Review a positive, a mixed edit and a changed-intent case; record an 'ambiguous' label on an unclear one. (4) Compare two same-input transform outputs (prefer A / B / tie / neither / uncertain). (5) Splits > Assign; Export selected views to a NEW folder; Validate; delete one source example and re-export - its rows disappear. semantic_review.summary: Audit of the inherited M14 implementation found and repaired, each with a regression test: the exporter deleted any existing folder given as its destination; a prefer_b judgment exported the rejected candidate as chosen and the first (not latest) judgment per pair; the Hub's action wrapper took no keyword arguments, so Approve/Reject/Label/Export failed on every click and errors landed in a hidden view; re-assigning splits hashed exposed families back into frozen_test and the exporter excluded exposed development families from any export including frozen_test; approval failed for canonicals already in the dictionary and after undo; the counterexample sandbox ignored the rule's scope (vacuous for app-scoped rules); contraction negations were invisible; stage attribution looked up the wrong keys and read the normalization ledger JSON as text; case-only re-casing bypassed the reliability gate; note mining attributed edits in multi-dictation notes to an arbitrary job; excluded examples mined; teach needed a training example; late sampling triggers never reached review and the explicit stratum was never produced; review_sample_percent was unread; the idle profile pass minted a snapshot every 30 minutes forever; cards cited arbitrary examples; hours were UTC; repeated-verbatim/background speech fed the profile; invalidated snapshots kept phrases from deleted speech; exports hashed whole files in RAM and never verified copied audio; the cleanup view's input was the raw text; stale family assignments, dead deletion_epoch literals and a consent bypass parameter; the mining scan limit applied before filtering; the profile compute and mining held the writer for ~235 ms (now chunked: worst dictation wait 45 ms / 1 ms); the export CLI migrated without a backup; the uncertain pair judgment was missing from the Hub; verbatim coverage in reviewed seconds was unreported.

review_loop.skill: /review-2 (two parallel read-only reviewers on Fable: a bug-hunting debugger; an architecture/quality/performance/security/data-integrity auditor)
review_loop.verdict_before_addressing: Request Changes - 3 criticals: (1, corroborated) deleted note/job content survived in learning candidates - propagation was example-keyed, missing job-only teaches, and note deletion never reached note-sourced candidates whose payload held the whole note; (2) transcript words in candidate rows (changed_spans_json, classification regions) and graft_json, plus a never-expiring training lease on every mined candidate that pinned the whole job past the unreviewed buffer; (3) record_label moved any example to annotated, resurrecting quarantined/expired evidence into export and the ASR gate. 10 warnings, 10 suggestions.
review_loop.addressed: All 3 criticals fixed with regression tests: job-keyed stale+clear in delete_everywhere and prune_training, note deletion purges candidate payloads and stales open candidates in its own op, note payloads keep only changed regions, rows carry offsets and axes only (a further leak found while fixing: classification_json carried region words), graft_json dropped, mined payloads take the buffer lease (teach stays reviewed/retained), labels and teach refuse non-trainable examples. Warnings: previous-export replacement only when every file is listed in its own sums; validator reports hostile JSON/non-string/traversal paths and symlinks instead of raising; approval records its plan before any vocabulary write and marks conditionally; quarantined examples out of the profile; one set of example-state constants and one artifact-text helper in store.py; tests for every new branch; contracts corrected; graft spans must index the source text; suppressed rows out of the queue (and job-only teaches now appear, a second latent gap); refusals raised after the op. Suggestions: consent refusal recorded; Generate failures shown; Export/Mine/Generate off the main thread; queue rows carry candidate_id; staging must be a leftover build folder; any failure removes staging and records failure; note-span intersection in one tokenizer; exposure read across all prior versions; scrub reasons name the evidence state. One suggestion decided without code change: the export selection stays one writer op because S29.13 requires a consistent source snapshot (measured worst dictation wait 50.6 ms at 10k examples, a user action). Nothing rejected as incorrect.
review_loop.post_address: 62/62 suites green on the final code (model-backed included; V1 control 51/51 in 46 s); the benchmark re-ran on the final code (docs/v2/benchmarks/20260924-010937-m14/m14.json).
review_loop.follow_up: After close-out, four documented limitations were closed in code with regression tests: dictated note spans record their producing job (M12 spans gain an optional fourth element that survives every rebase), so an edit in a multi-dictation note is attributed to the dictation it touched; the export finalize recheck concerns only its own inputs (purged inputs abort, unrelated deletions do not); the idle profile pass decides from counters without reading transcripts (p95 299 ms -> 38 ms); Your Voice gains the S22 self-correction and requested-output measured views with honest denominators. 62/62 suites green again (V1 control 51/51 in 48 s) and the benchmark re-ran.
review_loop.cadence_note: The /address per-fix commit+push cadence was adapted to this repo's milestone protocol: one close-out commit staged by name, no push.

privacy: Nothing private entered Git: every M14 fixture is synthetic (tests/v2/training/evidence_pack.py, Synth App names, example.com hosts); rows are ids/hashes/counts/offsets (candidate rows also name proposed rule terms) with observed words only in lease-governed artifacts inside the store; events carry ids/reasons/counts; the benchmark JSON holds timings/sizes over a temp-dir store; the baseline-manifest privacy scan passes; exports are written only to a user-chosen local folder, never uploaded.
